interpretation.plain_speak: A tiny correction based on Wingless's own native context removes essentially all aggregate over/under-prediction on three new phases. That is a much better use of the context signal than splitting the whole probability table. But the phases still come from the same repeating regime, so this needs a longer untouched replication before we trust the correction.
interpretation.north_star_question: Provides the strongest calibrated native failure-risk estimate so far, but only at aggregate event-mass level within the current repeating regime.
interpretation.next_stage: freeze the same two correction factors and evaluate unchanged on a longer untouched phase range 37-42, reporting both aggregate calibration and per-phase stability
